thread:
linda: Heads up — seeing a spike of 502s on hosted API /v1/generate around 09:12 UTC. Multiple customers hit failures and retries. nginx error lines show 'upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream'. Anyone on call?

oliver: On it. can you paste a sample trace id and a curl repro?

linda: trace=tx-8791b2. sample curl I ran: 
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{"prompt":"hello\nlong prompt..."}' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
Response was immediate 502 Bad Gateway. nginx header showed upstream address 10.12.3.45:8080.

maria: FYI deploy-bot shows a model-serving deploy at 09:10 UTC (dpl-202-33) — could correlate. memory/concurrency knobs changed in that image.

deploy-bot: Deployment dpl-202-33 completed by ingrid at 2025-06-21T09:10:05Z — service: model-serving-prod — image: rwd-model:2025-06-21-1234

ingrid: I only changed the model container (increased tokenization threads). No nginx config touched. Might be increasing upstream connection churn.

jon: Sounds like upstream closed under load. Envoy/nginx connection pool exhaustion or h2 resets. Check envoy stats for `upstream_cx_overflow` and `upstream_rq_5xx`. Also look at sidecar h2 resets.

maria: Envoy metrics: h2 reset rate spiked at 09:12, sidecar `cx_overflow` counters incrementing on model nodes.

oliver: Mitigations we can do now: (1) temporarily route traffic to dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-capacity-2) (2) scale model-serving replicas + increase keepalive connections (3) bump nginx proxy_read_timeout to 120s and proxy_buffer_size to 16k for edge for the short term.

linda: Customer-facing workaround: ask clients to increase retry backoff, we've informed affected accounts.

jon: Repro steps for SRE/eng-runtime:
1) run k6 script hitting /v1/generate at 100 concurrency (short prompts then long prompts)
2) run the curl above including `-v` to capture headers
3) grep nginx error logs for the trace id `tx-8791b2` for context

linda: attaching nginx error snippet we captured: 
```text
2025/06/21 09:12:17 [error] 23456#0: *12345 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 34.56.78.90, server: api.redwood-inference.com, request: \"POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\", upstream: \"http://10.12.3.45:8080/\", host: \"api.redwood-inference.com\", request_id: \"tx-8791b2\"
```

oliver: I'm opening an incident P0 and paging eng-runtime. assigning to @jon and @lucas. Need tcpdump on the model pod and the host to see FIN/RST patterns. Also check ulimit/accept backlog and whether the sidecar is dropping streams.

lucas: On it. will collect tcpdump and strace. Also check for any abrupt SIGKILLs in kube events and OOMs.

ingrid: Rolling back dpl-202-33 now (starting rollback).

deploy-bot: Rollback started for deployment dpl-202-33 by ingrid at 2025-06-21T09:18:02Z

maria: After rollback, 502 rate dropped back to baseline (~0.7%) within ~4 minutes. Keeping traffic on fallback pool and monitoring for 30m.

linda: Great — I'll update the customer tickets and send a short status note. Thanks all for quick triage.

oliver: Action items: incident INC-789 opened, eng-runtime to perform RCA (check connection pooling, sidecar h2 behavior, and model image change), follow-up postmortem and config recommendations.

linda: noted. will link INC-789 to support case and schedule a postmortem sync. :thumbsup:
